hook.en: If a machine will serve for 5 years, why not charge an equal share of its cost every year? That simple idea is the straight line method.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಯಂತ್ರ 5 ವರ್ಷ ಸೇವೆ ನೀಡಿದರೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಅದರ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಸಮಾನ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ವಿಧಿಸಬಾರದು? ಈ ಸರಳ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯೇ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಕಂತು ವಿಧಾನ.

objectives.en: Calculate annual depreciation and its rate by SLM.
Charge depreciation for part of a year.
State the merits and limitations of SLM.

narration.en: If a machine will serve for 5 years, why not charge an equal share of its cost every year? That simple idea is the straight line method.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಯಂತ್ರ 5 ವರ್ಷ ಸೇವೆ ನೀಡಿದರೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಅದರ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಸಮಾನ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ವಿಧಿಸಬಾರದು? ಈ ಸರಳ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯೇ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಕಂತು ವಿಧಾನ.

body.en: Under this method a fixed amount is charged as depreciation every year, so the book value falls in a straight line to the residual value at the end of the useful life. The rate is expressed as a percentage of the original cost. For an asset bought during the year, depreciation is charged only for the months it was used.

points.en: Annual depreciation = (Cost − Residual value) ÷ Useful life
Simple; asset can be written down to zero or scrap value
Burden on profit rises in later years as repairs increase

narration.en: Under this method a fixed amount is charged as depreciation every year, so the book value falls in a straight line to the residual value at the end of the useful life. The rate is expressed as a percentage of the original cost. For an asset bought during the year, depreciation is charged only for the months it was used.
narration.kn: ಈ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಒಂದೇ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಸವಕಳಿ ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ನೇರ ರೇಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ವರ್ಷದ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದರೆ ಬಳಸಿದ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸವಕಳಿ.

title.en: On the board: Straight line method

say.en: Cost 2 lakh, residual value 10 thousand, life 5 years. The same depreciation every year.
The rate is depreciation as a percentage of the original cost.
Book value falls by the same 38 thousand each year: a straight line.
After three years: 2 lakh minus 1,14,000 leaves a book value of 86,000.

caption.en: Book value under SLM is a straight line: y = Cost − D × t, falling by the same amount each year.

tryThis.en: Plot the line y = 200 − 38t (₹ thousand) to model the machine in the worked example.
Read the book value at t = 3 and check that it is 86.

narration.en: Book value under SLM is a straight line: y = Cost − D × t, falling by the same amount each year. Plot the line y = 200 − 38t (₹ thousand) to model the machine in the worked example. Read the book value at t = 3 and check that it is 86.

caption.en: Book value after x years = C − D·x, where D = (C − S) ÷ n. The graph is a straight line ending at the residual value.

narration.en: Move the sliders and watch the straight line of book value.

tryThis.en: Default values: check D = ₹38,000 and the rate 19%.
Make the life longer. What happens to the slope?
Set the residual value to zero. Where does the line end?

homework.en: A van costing ₹6,00,000 with residual value ₹60,000 lasts 6 years. Find the annual depreciation and the rate.

narration.en: Recap. SLM charges the same amount of depreciation every year. D = (Cost − Residual value) ÷ Useful life. Cost includes installation and transport. For part of a year, charge only for the months used.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸ್ಥಿರ ಕಂತು ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಒಂದೇ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಸವಕಳಿ. ಸವಕಳಿ = (ವೆಚ್ಚ − ಉಳಿಕೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯ) ÷ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಅವಧಿ. ವೆಚ್ಚದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಗಣೆ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ. ವರ್ಷದ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಿದ ತಿಂಗಳುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸವಕಳಿ.
